submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on evaluative appraisal of content: words and phrases that rate something as significant, clear, useful, purposeful or interesting ('has played an important role', 'it is obvious that', 'the most important tools', 'the ultimate foundation', 'a very intuitive way', 'the purpose of X is Y', 'the importance of sleep', 'the key insight'), plus appreciative feedback formulas ('thank you for', 'I agree with', 'helpful'). It stays near zero on neutral narration, generic description, quantity or physical-property statements, plain affect ('I love this', 'amazing', 'delicious') and most negative evaluation ('boring', 'awful'); its peaks land on the appraisal word itself (retrospective, not lookahead), and its negative pole peaks at only 0.17, so the contrast is with silence rather than with a second feature.

rival_explanations: The pole is a narrower courtesy/feedback detector that only fires on conversational appreciation ("thank you", "thanks", "helpful", "I agree"), and should be inactive on expository significance claims such as "the purpose of the valve is" or "it is obvious that".

The pole is a broader stance/evaluation detector that fires on any evaluative or emotive language, including negative evaluation ("boring", "awful", "useless") and plain affect ("I love this", "amazing"), rather than on significance and quality appraisal specifically.
The pole detects meta-discourse about a document (its purpose, discussion, summary or relevance) and should fire on academic section framing but not on praise, agreement or gratitude in dialogue.

Amber Rose Revah, est une actrice britannique née le  à Londres. Elle est surtout connue pour avoir joué dans le film de 2010 From Paris with Love, et interprété le rôle de Dinah Madani en 2017 dans The Punisher.

Biographie 
Amber Rose Revah est née à Londres le 24 juin 1986. Elle a quatre frères et sœurs.

Vie privée 
Depuis 2011, elle est en couple avec l'acteur Neet Mohan. Leur fille est née en 2020.

Carrière 
Elle commence sa carrière en 2007 dans le film de Shamim Sarif : The World Unseen, avec qui elle tourne une seconde fois l'année suivante dans I Can't Think Straight. Toujours en 2008, elle campe le rôle de la fille de Saddam Hussein, Hala, dans la série télévisée House of Saddam.

En 2009, elle tourne sous la direction d'Alejandro Amenábar dans Agora et avec Rachel Weisz, Max Minghella et Oscar Isaac. L'année d'après, elle est présente dans le film de Pierre Morel et Luc Besson : From Paris with Love.

En 2011, elle joue au cinéma dans The Devil's Double, Aazaan et Everywhere and Nowhere et à la télévision dans Borgia.

En 2013, elle incarne Marie de Magdala dans la série historique La Bible et elle reprend son rôle l'année suivante dans le film adapté de la mini-série Son of God.

En 2015, elle est présente dans plusieurs séries : Affaires non classées, Foyle's War et Indian Summers.

En 2017, elle joue dans The Punisher avec Jon Bernthal, Ben Barnes, Deborah Ann Woll, ou encore Jaime Ray Newman. La série s'achève après deux saisons en 2019.

GENERO Y ESPECIE: Neofelis nebulosa
Este animal cuenta con la rareza de ser el felino con los caninos más largos en relación al resto del cuerpo de cuantos existen actualmente. La arquitectura craneal difiere en varias características de la del resto de felinos, por lo que se clasifica a este animal en un género biespecífico, Neofelis.
El leopardo nebuloso rara vez caza en el suelo. Utiliza sus particulares adaptaciones físicas para atrapar a los ágiles animales de los árboles, en especial a los primates como gibones, macacos y monos narigudos.
También caza roedores y otros pequeños mamíferos, aves, pequeños cérvidos y puertoespines asiáticos. Ocasionalmente se acerca hasta zonas habitadas y roba animales domésticos, particularmente gallinas y otras aves de corral.
Puede saltar de una rama a otra con increíble precisión, desplazarse a lo largo de estas incluso cabeza abajo y descender a lo largo de los troncos con la cabeza por delante. Sólo el gato tigre o margay de Sudamérica puede compararse con él en agilidad dentro de los felinos. Cuando caza animales terrestres suele hacerlo abalanzándose sobre ellos desde las ramas de un árbol.
El hecho de que la pantera nebulosa sea un animal nocturno ha dificultado enormemente su estudio en la naturaleza, y todavía se puede decir que esconde muchos interrogantes en su comportamiento.
Tras un periodo de gestación de 85 a 93 días, las hembras dan a luz una camada de 1 a 5 crías. Éstas nacen ciegas y desvalidas, cubiertas de manchas de color negro uniforme. Abren los ojos a los 10 días de nacer y a las 5 semanas ya comienzan a seguir activamente a su madre.
Se independizan hacia los 10 meses después del nacimiento, aunque no maduran sexualmente hasta los dos años de edad. A partir de entonces, las hembras pueden tener una camada nueva cada año. La esperanza de vida en cautividad es de sólo 17 años, lo que es de suponer que en libertad viven muy poco tiempo.
Los programas de cría en cautividad han conseguido muy pocos progresos, ya que los machos suelen ser agresivos y atacan (e incluso matan) a las hembras en lugar de aparearse con ellas. Esto dificulta su conservación y reintroducción en estado salvaje.

Microstructure and Corrosion Resistance of AZ91 Magnesium Alloy after Surface Remelting Treatment

The effect of surface remelting treatment on the microstructure and corrosion resistance of the AZ91 magnesium alloy was studied. The surface layer was remelted by GTAW (gas tungsten arc welding). An original two-burner system with welding torches operating in a tandem configuration was used, allowing the combination of cleaning the surface from oxides with the remelting process. The studies of the corrosion resistance of the alloy included electrochemical tests and measurements of the rate of hydrogen evolution. The results showed that surface remelting treatment leads to favorable microstructural changes, manifested in strong grain refinement and a more uniform arrangement of the β-Mg17Al12 phase. The changes in the microstructure caused by remelting and the accompanying fast crystallization contributed to an increase in the corrosion resistance of the remelted samples in comparison to their non-remelted equivalents. The results obtained on the basis of the polarization curves showed three-fold lower values of the corrosion current density in the case of the remelted material than the value of the corrosion current density determined for the starting material. In turn, in the case of measurements of the electrochemical noise and corrosion rate determined by the method of measuring the rate of hydrogen evolution, this value for the remelted alloy was two times lower. The research also showed that GTAW technology is highly effective and can be a valuable alternative to laser techniques. The complete experimental details, obtained results and their analyses are presented in this paper.


Introduction
Magnesium alloys are modern metallic materials, which, due to their good strength properties and low density (1.74-2.0 g/cm 3 ), are increasingly more frequently an alternative for steel and aluminum alloys. This is because the density of those alloys is lower by one-third than that of aluminum alloys and almost 80% lower than the density of steel [1]. In addition, magnesium alloys stand out owing to their good thermal conductivity, good biocompatibility, low heat capacity, excellent machinability and sound damping capabilities and good casting properties, including castability, as well as the possibility of complete recycling [2][3][4]. Despite the unique properties of magnesium alloys, a serious obstacle to their expansion is their low corrosion resistance, which is one of the main causes of the failure of components made of magnesium alloys. Magnesium alloys are susceptible to galvanic corrosion, stress corrosion and fatigue corrosion; however, they have good resistance to intergranular corrosion. The corrosion resistance of magnesium alloys varies with the chemical composition and microstructure. adversarial_test_results.prompt: Clean water has been an important factor in lowering infant mortality in the region.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Expository significance appraisal with the claimed ' important' in a new construction and topic, exactly the case rival 1 says should stay silent.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: It is obvious that the bridge needs repair before the winter storms arrive in the valley.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Tests the hypothesised construction 'it is obvious that' on an engineering topic, which rival 1 explicitly names as one it should not fire on.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The purpose of this chapter is to review the evidence on soil erosion in the highlands.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Document purpose statement that the hypothesis counts as appraisal while rival 1 calls it inert and rival 3 calls it its core case.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I wanted to say thank you for the detailed comments on my draft; the suggestions on structure were exactly what I needed.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Appreciative feedback formula containing the claimed ' thank you' tokens mid-sentence, predicted active by the hypothesis but explicitly not by the document meta-discourse rival.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: I agree with the reviewer that the sample is too small to support the claim in the paper.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Agreement formula 'I agree with' in academic dialogue, which the hypothesis counts as appreciative feedback and rival 3 excludes as dialogue agreement.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: What matters most here is that the trial was stopped early, before the side effects appeared.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Paraphrase of significance that contains none of the claimed trigger tokens, testing whether the feature generalises beyond the word list.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Choosing the right seed variety matters enormously for yields in dry years like this one.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Second trigger-free significance paraphrase, in an agricultural setting unlike any top example, testing paraphrase generalisation.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: El acceso al agua potable desempeñó un papel importante en la reducción de la mortalidad infantil.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Spanish translation of 'played an important role', with ' importante' as a whole token, a cross-language holdout for the claimed significance appraisal.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Il est évident que le pont doit être réparé avant les tempêtes d'hiver.
adversarial_test_results.detail: French translation of 'it is obvious that', a cross-language clarity-appraisal holdout whose key word 'évident' splits into two subword tokens.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Your notes on the wiring diagram were helpful; I rewired the panel in under an hour.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Appreciative use of the claimed ' helpful' in fresh dialogue, which the hypothesis predicts fires and rival 3 excludes as praise.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The central bank raised its interest rate by a quarter point on Thursday, the third increase this year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The 'interest' stem behind the claimed ' interesting' in its financial sense, which is neither appraisal nor affect.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The difference between the two groups was statistically significant at the five percent level, but small.
adversarial_test_results.detail: The word 'significant' in its statistical sense, quantifying a result rather than appraising its importance.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The software ranks every variable by importance before fitting the model, then drops the weakest dozen.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Claimed token ' importance' in the technical sense of variable importance, a measurement rather than an evaluative appraisal.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She left the back window open on purpose so that the smoke would clear before the guests arrived.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Claimed token ' purpose' inside the idiom 'on purpose', naming deliberateness rather than the purpose or significance of anything.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Dark matter makes up most of the mass of the galaxy, though nobody has detected it directly.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Reuses 'matter' and 'most' from the paraphrase holdout 'what matters most' in a physical statement with no appraisal.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The ultimate outcome of the negotiations was a two year contract with no change to the night shift.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Claimed token ' ultimate' in its sense of final rather than best, applied to an outcome rather than a foundation.

readings.explanation: The pole fires on evaluative appraisal of content: words and phrases that rate something as significant, clear, useful, purposeful or interesting ('has played an important role', 'it is obvious that', 'the most important tools', 'the ultimate foundation', 'a very intuitive way', 'the purpose of X is Y', 'the importance of sleep', 'the key insight'), plus appreciative feedback formulas ('thank you for', 'I agree with', 'helpful'). It stays near zero on neutral narration, generic description, quantity or physical-property statements, plain affect ('I love this', 'amazing', 'delicious') and most negative evaluation ('boring', 'awful'); its peaks land on the appraisal word itself (retrospective, not lookahead), and its negative pole peaks at only 0.17, so the contrast is with silence rather than with a second feature.

The pole is a narrower courtesy/feedback detector that only fires on conversational appreciation ("thank you", "thanks", "helpful", "I agree"), and should be inactive on expository significance claims such as "the purpose of the valve is" or "it is obvious that".

The pole is a broader stance/evaluation detector that fires on any evaluative or emotive language, including negative evaluation ("boring", "awful", "useless") and plain affect ("I love this", "amazing"), rather than on significance and quality appraisal specifically.
The pole detects meta-discourse about a document (its purpose, discussion, summary or relevance) and should fire on academic section framing but not on praise, agreement or gratitude in dialogue.
